Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Price basis 1.4404 bar (part:370010) – 24-month proposal
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your quotation and for the information on your cost drivers.

We would like to give you what your sales director has said matters to you: committed volume. We propose a 24-month agreement covering our full annual need of 23,700 kg of 1.4404 bar at 14 days lead time, DAP.

We also note that your quotation of 9 September for the same part was EUR 6.06. In our previous price rounds we always found a basis well below the initial request. We expect the same partnership approach here, given the longer commitment we are offering.

You proposed a price adjustment clause based on AS-14404. We are open to this, but only with a deadband and a base price that reflects the material risk we would then carry instead of you.

We offer the following packages. Each has the same value to us, so please choose the one that suits you best:

1) EUR 5.18 per kg, 24 months, payment 90 days net, no index clause.
2) EUR 5.14 per kg, 24 months, payment 60 days net, no index clause.
3) EUR 5.13 per kg, 24 months, payment 90 days net, with an AS-14404 clause (material share 45 %, 5 % deadband, base month 2026-08).

We look forward to your response.

Kind regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.subject: Re: Angebot part:370010 – updated packages, 24 months
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your quick reply and for confirming the 24-month term and the AS-14404 clause.

You asked for the figures behind our view. We use the published series you cite, over the same twelve-month windows:
- AS-14404 changed +5.92 %.
- PPI-C2431 changed +12.26 %.
- LCI-C changed +2.66 %.

We accept that your costs have moved. Our point is a different one. With a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, the material share of 45 % is no longer your risk but ours. The base price therefore has to be a price without a material-risk premium.

Two weeks ago, on 9 September, you quoted us EUR 6.06 for this part. That was a fixed price for 12 months, with no clause. Your packages now ask for both an index clause and a base price only modestly below that level. In each of our past price rounds we found a common basis clearly below the opening request, and we are now offering two years of committed volume in return.

We have moved our position and also included the structure you prefer: index clause with 30 days net. The three packages below have the same value to us, so please choose the one that suits you best:

1) EUR 5.28 per kg, 24 months, payment 90 days net, no index clause.
2) EUR 5.23 per kg, 24 months, payment 90 days net, with the AS-14404 clause (material share 45 %, 5 % deadband, base month 2026-08).
3) EUR 5.16 per kg, 24 months, payment 30 days net, with the AS-14404 clause (material share 45 %, 5 % deadband, base month 2026-08).

All three are at 14 days lead time and DAP, for our full need of 23,700 kg per year.

We look forward to your response.

Kind regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.subject: 1.4404 bar part:370010 – updated packages incl. tighter deadband option
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised offer and for moving your base price.

We have listened to what matters to you: the AS-14404 clause, your standard 30 days net, and two years of committed volume. All three are now in our proposal. The open point is the base price.

With the clause, the material share of 45 % moves from your risk to ours. A base price close to your fixed-price level therefore no longer fits the structure. On 9 September you quoted us EUR 6.06 for this part as a fixed price for 12 months, without any clause.

To meet you further, we add a new option with a tighter deadband of 3 %. This protects you against material movements earlier and to a greater extent, so we can only offer it at a correspondingly lower base price.

The three packages below have the same value to us. Please choose the one that suits you best:

1) EUR 5.34 per kg, 24 months, payment 90 days net, no index clause.
2) EUR 5.23 per kg, 24 months, payment 30 days net, AS-14404 clause (material share 45 %, 5 % deadband, base month 2026-08).
3) EUR 5.18 per kg, 24 months, payment 30 days net, AS-14404 clause (material share 45 %, 3 % deadband, base month 2026-08).

All packages are for our full need of 23,700 kg per year, at 14 days lead time, DAP, valid from 1 January 2027.

We look forward to your response.

Kind regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.subject: Re: Price basis 1.4404 bar – faster payment or 36-month commitment
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised offer of EUR 5.50 per kg. We note that you prefer the 5 % deadband over a tighter one, and we have taken the 3 % option off the table.

We understand that your other cost drivers have moved, and we are not disputing that. Our point is still the structure. With the AS-14404 clause, we carry the material risk on 45 % of your cost, so the base price must not contain a material-risk premium as well.

To help you close the remaining gap, we now add two things you have told us matter to you:
- faster cash, with payment in 14 days;
- an even longer volume commitment of 36 months for our full need.

The three packages below have the same value to us, so please choose the one that suits you best:

1) EUR 5.26 per kg, 24 months, payment 30 days net, AS-14404 clause (material share 45 %, 5 % deadband, base month 2026-08).
2) EUR 5.24 per kg, 24 months, payment 14 days net, AS-14404 clause (material share 45 %, 5 % deadband, base month 2026-08).
3) EUR 5.26 per kg, 36 months, payment 30 days net, AS-14404 clause (material share 45 %, 5 % deadband, base month 2026-08).

All packages cover our full need of 23,700 kg per year, at 14 days lead time, DAP, valid from 1 January 2027.

We look forward to your response.

Kind regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
